test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: From the salary of a software engineer, if 15% is used as house rent, 25% of the remaining is spent on household items, 25% of the remaining as income tax, and 15% of the remaining on clothing, then he is left with Rs. 10,404. Find his total salary.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **total salary** be 100%.

Remaining salary after all deductions ⇒ 100 × (85/100) × (75/100) × (75/100) × (85/100) = 10,404

Total Salary = 10,404 × (100/85) × (100/75) × (100/75) × (100/85)

Total Salary = 10,404 × (20/17) × (4/3) × (4/3) × (20/17) = 25,600

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 25,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bdc0e12629f1ae29dd43681f8df3e4984288b89aefd7574b15bb10b9a5a06a9.png] 

**Given:**

House Rent = 15% | Household = 25% (Remaining) | Tax = 25% (Remaining) | Clothing = 15% (Remaining)

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = Initial Value × (100 − r₁)/100 × (100 − r₂)/100 ...

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total salary be **S**.

⇒ S × (1 − 0.15) × (1 − 0.25) × (1 − 0.25) × (1 − 0.15) = 10,404

⇒ S × (0.85) × (0.75) × (0.75) × (0.85) = 10,404

⇒ S × (17/20) × (3/4) × (3/4) × (17/20) = 10,404

⇒ S × (26,01/64,00) = 10,404

⇒ S = (10,404 × 6400) ÷ 2601

⇒ S = 4 × 6400 = 25,600

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 25,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When values are deducted from the **remaining balance**, we use the multiplying factor (100 − r)/100 for each step.

Base Change Rule

If expenses are given as a % of the **total**, they are simply added; if given as a % of **remaining**, they are multiplied.</p
